title: Content pack data (content.json)
description: An array of {kind, id, data} entries. Each kind's `data` is validated by the content-kind loader registered by the plugin that owns the kind (TypeScript), so only the envelope is described here. Arrays cannot carry $schema: editors map content.json through .vscode/settings.json.

id.description: Namespaced id like "core/world" (lowercase, at least one slash).
